summary: Tested public API and core UI role flows. All six API regression tests passed; login, invalid-login handling, Pembina attendance/journal, and Siswa artwork/report flows worked. Logout did not return the UI to login in two independent browser runs.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking [data-testid=logout-btn] leaves the authenticated dashboard visible instead of returning to login; reproduced for Pembina and Siswa after 1.5-3 seconds.

Dashboard handlers for attendance, journals, grades, students, artworks, and feedback use React local state/toasts rather than the implemented backend CRUD APIs; changes are not persisted across reloads or sessions.

action_items: Fix logout promise/state transition so the login screen is rendered after POST /api/auth/logout completes or fails.
Connect frontend CRUD actions and initial data loading to backend APIs; remove reliance on local-only state for required persistence.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js contains the complete UI in one large module and duplicates local demo data alongside backend data models.
Backend auth has no brute-force lockout after five failed attempts, despite auth testing guidance requesting this verification.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST topic, TEST student, and TEST artwork through API tests; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL is https://photography-tracker-1.preview.emergentagent.com. API auth/health/access tests pass. Logout UI failure reproduced in separate Pembina and Siswa sessions. UI core flows are local-state based.
rca of the issue: Logout button awaits fetch('/api/auth/logout') before setCurrentUser(null). Browser automation showed the click leaves the dashboard, indicating the awaited cross-origin request is not resolving/continuing in the UI path. Backend logout itself returned 200 in requests tests, so investigate browser CORS/cookie response and add finally-based state reset/error handling.
